title: task-tree overrides
description: Editor aid for overrides.json. The task-tree compiler is the authority: it also checks that dimensions, values, types, tasks, states and attribute values exist and are in scope, which this schema cannot express.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

overrides.description: Overrides by dimension, then by dimension value.

name.description: Non-blank, without leading or trailing whitespace.

valueOverrides.description: What changes for types and tasks when the dimension has this value.

tasks.description: Overrides by task id; applied after the task's type override.

states.description: States removed from or added to the type in this context.

customAttributes.description: Custom attribute values in this context, by attribute name, then by state.
